input.name: features
input.layout: the flow embedding (columns 0-31) followed by the context vector (columns 32-131)
input.note: standardised inside the model with the scaler in detector.safetensors; send raw values

output.probabilities: one per class, benign first, then each family in `families` order
output.alert: probability >= serve_threshold for that family, when serve_threshold is set

decision_rules.note: applied by the caller across consecutive events on one host; the endpoint scores single events
